name: Amarshi

queries.query: Amarshi West Bengal official cadastral map land records Banglarbhumi parcel map Purba Medinipur
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of West Bengal Banglarbhumi land-record portal, which exposes Plot Map Request, Mouza Map Request, plot information, and RS-LR information. Official Purba Medinipur sources identify Amarshi Kasba as being in Patashpur-I and identify district land-and-land-reforms administration. No open Amarshi parcel feature response was found.
